summary: Tested backend (pytest, 10/10 passing) and frontend (full admin flow end-to-end via Playwright). PRIMARY CONCERN RESOLVED: Admin login with Admin/Urdal successfully redirects to /dashboard, token is persisted in localStorage['rapat_token'], and ProtectedRoute lets the admin in without bouncing back. All critical features work: schedule CRUD, 409 overlap conflict toast ('Bentrok jadwal!'), Belum Bersurat filter + table-info count, Cetak Rekap dialog with column checkboxes + PDF/Excel buttons, Share Jadwal dialog with /jadwal link, public /jadwal (no edit/delete, phone hidden), /display airport-board (dark table with all columns + status badges), /setting page (footers, add/remove rooms, add/remove petugas).

issues: Date inputs use browser-native type='date' (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of a shadcn Calendar/DatePicker. Minor; functional but inconsistent with design system guidance.
Same browser-native date picker used; consider shadcn Calendar for consistency.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Replace native <input type=date> in ExportDialog, Dashboard filter, and PublicJadwal filter with shadcn Calendar/Popover DatePicker for consistency.
(Optional) Add aria-describedby or <DialogDescription> to the shadcn Dialogs to silence console a11y warnings (purely cosmetic warning).
critical_code_review_comments: Auth is single hardcoded admin via env vars (ADMIN_USERNAME/ADMIN_PASSWORD) with JWT 7-day expiry; appropriate for stated requirement.
Overlap conflict logic (times_overlap + check_conflict) is correct and tested (409 returned + handled by UI toast).
Image compression via Pillow at quality=40 and max 1600px — PDFs correctly passed through without compression. Good.
MongoDB _id is excluded via projection ({'_id': 0}) in all queries — correct.
/api/schedules?public=true strips no_wa — verified both via API and UI.
server.py is 325 lines, acceptable size, no split required.
seed_data_creation: Backend test creates & cleans up TEST_ schedules; the Playwright flow created and then deleted a TEST schedule for 2027-02-10 Tepian 2.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 10 tests, all green). Admin login flow is confirmed working end-to-end. All data-testid selectors from the review request are present and correct. No critical issues found — only minor design note about native date pickers vs shadcn Calendar.
rca of the issue: Previous agent reported the login->dashboard flow as UNVERIFIED because screenshot tool did not reflect typed input. Playwright (real browser) confirms the flow works: POST /api/auth/login returns {token, username}; AuthContext stores token in localStorage['rapat_token'] and sets user; ProtectedRoute allows access to /dashboard. No bug — tooling limitation on the previous agent's side.
